cases.intent: A cloner can find a root launcher without reading the README first.
./start.sh runs without chmod after a unix clone.
Required keys are listed in a committed template.
.env.example is not swallowed by the .env* gitignore rule.
The template names the two keys the homepage actually reads.
npm run start:app is a documented alias for the same launcher.
The ignore exception stays in .gitignore so a future clone still has the template.
Env parsing, placeholders, and HTTP wait still behave as specified.
Getting Started tells a new cloner the one command to run.
